historical_reference_us.note: Section 19.143 recorded product miss_replace median 12,593 / p95 13,410 on an unloaded machine before this change; this session ran under concurrent build load, so only the same-run A/B is compared directly.

The two checksum strings come from different test helpers and are not compared with each other.

shell_retention_hunk.behavior: On a revision change the shell keeps the cached match sets only when flow::same_canonical_revisions says the canonical GraphRef sequence is identical (projection-counter-only change); otherwise it clears them. Authorization loss, scope switch and every canonical revision change still clear at their own sites.

ten_thousand_revision_change_series.note: display_total = layers + match + diagram, not frame latency. Query changes remain a real content change and still rebuild the match sets.

reached: A publication-version-only or projection-counter-only admission-key change reuses the already-built match set; the 13-17 ms rebuild is skipped on the display thread.
Same-run publication-only display interval p95 4.29 / 4.68 ms (median 3.51 / 3.36 ms) against the 8.33 ms UI-period target; the same-run rebuild baseline was p95 19.82 / 16.24 ms.
The incremental output is checksum-equal to a full rebuild and to the independent BTreeSet reference, and the diagram is exactly equal.
The shell keeps the cache across a projection-counter-only revision change and still clears it on authorization loss, scope switch and every canonical revision change.
No painter/element/pin/dependency/unsafe change; labels, accessibility, list/search route and displayed topology are untouched (frame-phase checksum unchanged).
not_measured_or_held: paint / submit / GPU / Present / input-to-photon: NOT_MEASURED.
Real Runtime projection graphs: NOT_MEASURED (synthetic 100x100 graph only).
Query-change replace remains a full rebuild (a real content change): miss_replace p95 24,345 us in this loaded run, above 8.33 ms; not claimed as improved.

Projection-counter-only path: the match set is reused, but the shell's layer cache is still keyed by the full RevisionKey, so layers recompute (~6.6 ms median this run). Publication-version-only changes do not change the revision key, so their layers stay cached. Reusing layers across a projection-counter-only change would need a further lib.rs change; NOT IMPLEMENTED in this slice.
Rows re-derivation (~0.7-0.8 ms) runs on the background job and is outside the display interval.
Single shared machine under concurrent build load; absolute values are not a hardware-matrix or SLO claim.
known_limits: The reuse predicate treats the canonical GraphRef sequence, the query and the session/epoch scope as the content identity. It relies on the contract invariant that a canonical GraphRef pins the authoritative node/edge content and labels (DC-MP-FLOW1 and rendering section 8.1 stage C keying); a re-projection under an unchanged GraphRef cannot legitimately change them.
The cache remains single-entry, shell-owned and bounded; there is no global state.
The measurements time CPU path generation only; they are not window frame times.
